title: Documentation: TYPO? ”Node tab” -> ”signals tab” on Heads up display
body: ### Tested versions Godot Docs - en - 4.6 https://docs.godotengine.org/en/4.6/getting_started/first_2d_game/06.heads_up_display.html#connecting-hud-to-main ### System information Windows11 - Godot 4.6 ### Issue description Hi, there. Your documentation work is really excellent. As someone who just started using Godot, I’ve been greatly helped by these docs. I think I found what might be a TYPO. In the Your first 2D game tutorial, on the Heads up display page, the phrase “In the Node tab,” should actually be “In the Signals tab,” shouldn’t it? https://docs.godotengine.org/en/4.6/getting_started/first_2d_game/06.heads_up_display.html#connecting-hud-to-main ``` **In the Node tab**, connect the HUD's start_game signal to the new_game() function of the Main node by clicking the "Pick" button in the "Connect a Signal" window and selecting the new_game() method or type "new_game" below "Receiver Method" in the window. Verify that the green connection icon now appears next to func new_game() in the script. ``` In the current version (4.6), this is now the “Signals” tab, so I think this line might be leftover from an older version. Beginners don’t know the old terminology, so it can be confusing — I got quite lost myself. If this is indeed a mistake, fixing it would really help other newcomers as well. Of course, the tutorial as a whole has been extremely helpful. I’d be happy if you could take a look. thanks. ### Steps to reproduce Please refer to this URL https://docs.godotengine.org/en/4.6/getting_started/first_2d_game/06.heads_up_display.html#connecting-hud-to-main ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) In the Your first 2D game tutorial, on the Heads up display page, the phrase “In the Node tab,” should actually be “In the Signals tab,” shouldn’t it?
